study: E8 staged symbolic search with generic basis and derived features
scope: E8 registered whole-six-development-world attempts; R03/R04 are the user-authorized paired no-noise/noisy evaluation of one frozen corrected implementation. Earlier batches and failures retained. No per-world answer templates or oracle labels in production.

pre_agent_validation.mode: B only: one production staged run_search per world through an isolated warmed service on port 8891; no exact-label A search.
pre_agent_validation.dataset: experiments/E5/symbolic-identifiability-20261107-r01/dataset.json: 24 training and 8 heldout trajectories per world, each with 50 observations; only training probes enter the service.
pre_agent_validation.input: Frozen acquired/diagnostic probe observations only; independent exact holdout labels may score after search but never select, fit or initialize candidate formulas.
pre_agent_validation.role: Check implementation viability before the Agent batch, not choose the best per-world configuration. Every result and failure remains visible.

agent_batch.independent_evaluation: All fixed v15 cases after accepted submission, evaluated without noise; not official contest scores.

launch_preconditions: Source frozen and scientific hashes include every generic basis/feature module, conditional prompt, driver, configuration and protocol.
Four 27B endpoints respond with the expected model and zero running/waiting inference requests; no active user exploration.
Symbolic service has four warmed, idle workers; service startup uses a fixed local Julia executable and depot, offline mode and both thread variables set to four.
Independent no-search Julia preflight confirms the actual thread count is four; its environment whitelist and result are recorded in the batch manifest.
No prior experiment or run directory is reused. Baseline web defaults keep symbolic regression disabled.
reporting: Retain all six attempts, including failures, incomplete submissions and evaluation failures.
Per-world exploration, evaluation and total time; total completion tokens, mean output tokens per actual API call, per-call maximum and limit violations.
Actual symbolic search calls, stages, raw/component/joint candidates, Agent fitting/adoption and final independently evaluated law.
Keep offline checks, autonomous Agent scores and any posthoc analyses clearly separate.
limitations: One six-world development batch does not establish generalization to nine unseen universes. The package must not import diagnostic oracle labels, stored reference laws or world-specific feature templates.

r01.source_audit: Intended commit 72d0fcf; immutable manifest hashes show schemas.py retained prior 20–30s/timeout guidance. web_jobs.py retained preexisting web changes by instruction. Other 35 scientific/driver paths match commit. See R01 source-verification.json.

r02.registration: Registered after R01 completed and before R02 source freeze or execution. One complete batch of six, not selected-world retries.
r02.inherits: All agent_batch settings, fixed evaluation, four identical 27B endpoints and single attempt per world. No model/prompt search between individual R02 worlds.
changes: Align complete scientific source and tool schema with the frozen commit, including the previously stale schema; preserve only explicitly exempt preexisting web_jobs.py.
Clarify normal bounded search termination with usable candidates so it is not treated as a failed tool.
Use generic experiment planning to obtain actual same-complete-state delayed-time controls before spending the exploration budget.
Encourage fitting a returned eligible joint candidate before rejecting or rewriting its formula.
Enforce the user-requested early-submission fit-error/time gate.
Keep all supported elementary unary operators available in the first stage and warm the exact operator enums before exploration; only maximum expression complexity differs between stages.
r02.rationale: R01 W4/W5 discarded complete usable candidates as timeout/complexity failures; W5 misattributed changed initial states to explicit time dependence; W6 lacked informative delayed same-state controls. R01 evidence and scores remain separately reported.
r02.source_gate: Before launch, compare every scientific runtime/hash path to the frozen commit; every path must match except explicitly preserved preexisting shore_agent/web_jobs.py. Archive hashes and any declared exception.
r02.selection_policy: Report the whole R02 batch alongside whole R01; never combine the best world from different batches.

prelaunch_user_constraints.early_submission: Submit/finalize allowed only if the submitted fitted law training position RMSE is strictly below 1e-5 OR actual remaining mission time is strictly below 40 seconds. Both explicit submission and automatic finalization obey this gate; model failures cannot bypass it.
prelaunch_user_constraints.operator_priority: All supported unary operators sin, cos, exp, sqrt, log, abs are available from the first stage with equal availability; powers remain in the binary operator set from the start. Stage 1 maxsize24 and stage2 maxsize48 differ in complexity budget, not operator family priority.
prelaunch_user_constraints.execution_note: 3c76e35 was deployed and warmed, but zero R02 Agent missions or searches had started when the early-submission and then equal-trigonometric-priority constraints arrived. R02 will use the subsequent frozen source incorporating all.
